forensic_evidence.interpretation: near-constant per-array quantiles indicate quantile normalisation; sorted vectors NOT exactly identical, indicating a post-normalisation adjustment (ComBat) was applied on top

frma_gate.entrezg_cdf_excluded_because: an ENTREZG CDF has ~20k probe sets, all plain '_at', and no AFFX controls; this set has 54,675 probe sets, 17,261 with non-plain suffixes, and 62 AFFX controls

format: version (the Entrez Gene alternative CDF version IF APPLICABLE)
documented_vector_objects.resolution: The package ships TWO separate vector objects. The 'hgu133ahsentrezgcdf' string in the DESCRIPTION refers to how the ALTERNATIVE Entrez object was built; the 'version' element is documented as present only 'if applicable'. The standard object is therefore standard-CDF keyed.
documented_vector_objects.verified_level: DOCUMENTATION (reference manual), not the loaded object

frma_gate.verdict: CONDITIONAL GO - identifier compatibility is established for our side (100% standard Affy grammar, frozen probe sets are strict subsets of the GPL570 platform) and the CDF ambiguity is resolved from the reference manual. The residual check - that the LOADED standard object yields exactly our 54,675 identifiers - requires installation and remains outstanding.
